deadline.value: Priority deadline December 15; applications are accepted and reviewed until January 15.
deadline.quote: Application deadline: December 15 (priority deadline; applications will be accepted and reviewed until January 15).

gre_general.value: General GRE scores are not required; submitting them is optional.
gre_general.quote: Physics and general GRE scores are not required (optional).

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is not required; submitting it is optional.
gre_subject.quote: Physics and general GRE scores are not required (optional).

fee_waiver.value: The department has a few fee waivers for applicants who faced adversity, but only US applicants are considered for now.
fee_waiver.quote: Our resources are extremely limited, and only US applicants are considered for the moment.

supervisor.value: Students start with two project advisors in a two-year initial research project and choose a thesis advisor by the end of the fall of year three.
supervisor.quote: A student admitted to PhD candidacy has until the end of the fall semester of their third year in the program to find a PhD thesis advisor and identify a Dissertation Thesis Committee.

funding.value: Nearly all PhD students are supported by teaching and research fellowships.
funding.quote: Nearly all of our students in the PhD program are supported by teaching and research fellowships.

entry_route.value: The program is designed to take a student from the bachelor's degree to the PhD in about six years.
entry_route.quote: Our graduate program requirements are designed to guide the average student from their bachelor's degree to a PhD within six years.

notes: Students not admitted to candidacy after the first two years receive a master's degree.
